test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement and arguments carefully and select the appropriate answer from the given options.

**Statement:**

Unemployment among youth has emerged as the biggest challenge in post-COVID-19 times.

**Arguments:**

I. Many small-scale industries stopped working during the COVID period.

II. People do not want to work in small scale industries.

options.text: I weakens while II strengthens the statement.
Both I and II strengthen the statement.
Both I and II weaken the statement.
II weakens while I strengthens the statement.

solution:
Statement: Unemployment among youth has emerged as the biggest challenge in post-COVID-19 times.

Argument I: Many small-scale industries stopped working during the COVID period at the cost of lockdown. This leaves many youth working in small-scale industries unemployed. Lack of capital inflow toward SSI lead to dy-function. This further strengthen unemployment. → **Argument I strengthens the statement.**

**Argument II:** People do not want to work in small-scale industries. This could lead to youth unemployment because of their unwillingness to make use of the opportunities in the small-scale industries due to lack of social security cover. → **Argument II strengthens the statement.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both I and II strengthen the statement."**
